origin.description: An origin, offered on the selection screen of the layers that list it.

icon.description: The item shown for this origin.

unchoosable.description: Hide it from the selection screen. It can still be given with commands, upgrades or `default_origin`.

order.description: Sorting order within the impact group, lower comes first.

loading_priority.description: A copy of this origin in another datapack only replaces this one when its priority is higher.

upgrades.description: Origins a player is switched to when they get an advancement.

origin_layer.description: A layer of origins. Players pick one origin per enabled layer.

order.description: Order of the layer screens, lower comes first.

origins.description: The origins offered in this layer. Copies of a layer in other datapacks add to this list unless `replace` is true.

replace.description: Replace the origins of earlier copies of this layer instead of adding to them.

missing_name.description: Name shown when the player has no origin in this layer.

missing_description.description: Description shown when the player has no origin in this layer.

allow_random.description: Offer a random choice on the selection screen.

allow_random_unchoosable.description: Let the random choice pick unchoosable origins.

exclude_random.description: Origins the random choice never picks.

default_origin.description: Given to players instead of showing this layer's screen.

auto_choose.description: Pick the origin automatically when only one is available.

hidden.description: Hide the layer from the selection screen and the origin info screen.

power.description: Fields every power has, next to the fields of its type.

hidden.description: Hide the power from the origin screen.

loading_priority.description: A copy of this power in another datapack only replaces this one when its priority is higher.

badges.description: Badges shown next to the power on the origin screen.

badge.description: A badge that powers can refer to by id in their `badges` list.

global_power_set.description: Powers given to every entity of the listed types.

entity_types.description: Entity types (or `#tags`) the powers apply to. Every entity when left out.

replace.description: Throw away earlier copies of this set.

condition.description: The advancement that triggers the upgrade.

origin.description: The origin the player is switched to.

announcement.description: A message shown to the player when they're upgraded.

layer_origin_entry.description: An origin id, or origins that are only offered when the condition passes.

view_origin.description: Title of the origin info screen.

entity_type_or_tag.description: An entity type id, or an entity type tag id starting with `#`.

recipe.description: A vanilla recipe with an extra `id` field.

origins:tooltip.description: Shows a sprite with a tooltip.

origins:keybind.description: Shows a sprite with a tooltip naming the key of the power. `%s` in the text is replaced by the key.

origins:crafting_recipe.description: Shows a sprite with a tooltip showing a recipe.
